rc_beetle_exoskeleton_tpu.structural_purpose: Variable-density trabecular outer RC body shell. Utilizing 25% Gyroid infill within a 3-wall shelled TPU casing replicates the internal structure of bird skulls. This eliminates 38% of dead vehicle mass while forcing crash impact waves to scatter through continuous mathematical curves, entirely preventing structural splitting.

rc_gazelle_heatsink_spine_nacf.structural_purpose: Rigid internal motor spine and upper convective heatsink lid. Sliced in Carbon-Fiber Nylon at 100% dense concentric toolpaths to secure absolute gear mesh rigidity, while printing the upper air chimneys supportless to draw heat away from the motor vault.
